description: Land Acquisition - Na-Otunna, Devenuwara D/S Division, Matara District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2047/03 of 27.11.2017 Ganga Inhala Korale D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired (including lot numbers, extents, locations, and features), notices to interested parties regarding compensation claims, and administrative details related to the acquisition process. This fits squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters.
